rock.status: Individual rock dimensions, density and mass are not measured by the available regional DEM. Use regional relief and roughness to prioritize a stereo/lidar survey.

cavity.status: No measured cavity geometry is supplied for this location. The DEM cannot establish the presence or absence of underground voids.

surfaceAssessment.scope: Planning estimates only. Regional DEMs do not detect individual rocks or underground voids. Geometry does not establish composition, connected cave extent, roof stability, access or route safety. Automatic DEM metrics are regional. A documented cavity reference is local to its own body/site; missing geometry is not inferred.

matrix.breakdown: The grid does not resolve wheel/soil contacts, rocks or cavities; native resolution and interpolation limit the test.
The index does not measure physical similarity; radar roughness in dB and CPR are not interchangeable.
Reduced gravity cannot be reproduced in the field on Earth; offloading weight keeps the mass and its inertia.
Earth’s atmosphere does not reproduce the thin CO₂ gas of Mars. The pressure reference is not a site measurement.
Sea-level pressure is not converted to local pressure, and there is no division by the lunar zero.
Earth air temperature is not surface temperature; there is no comparable Earth surface pair or synchronized series.
Ideal vacuum: no external convection. Mars: unknown h coefficient. There is no universal thermal factor.
Earth’s atmosphere and magnetic field alter the environment; solar irradiance in W/m² is not ionizing dose. There is no local dosimetry.
There is no grain-size distribution, cohesion, contact moisture or mechanical strength from samples; a DEM cannot determine them.

analogyAudit.limitation: Static load only; no dynamic, thermal or radiation equivalence. Does not certify GO/NO-GO.

caveats: Weather-model forecast, not a field observation.
The thermal window compares the shape and phase of the normalized diurnal curve; absolute temperatures do not match.
Earth saltation is the same process that feeds Martian dust storms, not the same intensity: on Mars u*t ≈ 1–1.5 m/s.

limitations: Active Earth expedition and its explicitly selected planetary comparison reference. No destination landing or target rover measurements are imported.
